verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Registrar API for 'searching, checking, registering' domains and dashboard registration of new domains, so domain search and availability checking exist as first-party capabilities. The evidence says nothing about how fast search is, whether it suggests alternate TLDs (only that 400+ TLDs are supported), or any policy against front-running searched names. Missing for 10: evidence of instant availability results, alternate TLD suggestions, a documented no-front-running/no-squatting policy, and hands-on corroboration of search speed and honesty.

support.subject: As a founder, domain search is fast and honest — instant availability, alternate TLD suggestions, and no lookup-then-squat games on names I searched

citations.quote: Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains through Cloudflare Registrar.
Register new domains, transfer existing ones, and manage your portfolio from the Cloudflare dashboard.
